# Fronton

> Fronton turns the MacBook notch into an interactive island: music with synced
> lyrics, a timer drawn around the notch, clipboard history, a file shelf,
> drag-to-translate, and a local AI assistant. It works with or without a
> physical notch. macOS 26, Apple Silicon. Made in Switzerland by an
> independent developer; sold through Polar as merchant of record.

The site is written in French (fronton.app), with English and German versions
at fronton.app/en/ and fronton.app/de/. All three are static HTML: the text is
in the page, no JavaScript needed to read it.

## What it does

- **Music and synced lyrics.** A band slides down under the notch and follows
  the song line by line, without opening anything, while you work. Apple Music
  and Spotify. Hovering it folds it away, so whatever it covered is clickable
  again. Lyrics also follow a video: the track is recognised by its sound
  (ShazamKit), then its lines land on the second.
- **Local AI assistant.** Runs on the Mac through Ollama, no account and no API
  key. The model loads on demand and gives the memory back after use. Web
  search is off by default; when switched on, only the question is sent to
  DuckDuckGo.
- **Drag to translate.** Drop any text on the notch and it comes back
  translated, on device. Ten languages, downloadable for offline use.
- **Per-app volume.** Which app is playing, at what level, on which output —
  mute one app, lower another, with an equaliser behind an opt-in switch.
- **Type and translate.** ⌃⌥T, then type anywhere: a second and a half without
  touching the keyboard and your sentence becomes its translation, in place.
- **Quick writing.** Drop a text on the right wing: fix, summarise, shorten or
  change the tone, by the local model.
- **Panel backgrounds.** Your own photo behind the open panel, cropped and
  zoomed, or one of five backgrounds drawn for the island.
- **Timer, clipboard history, file shelf, brightness on connected displays,
  face unlock and hand gestures (both experimental, off by default).**

## The rule it follows

Fronton triggers, summarises, remembers or hands back. It never becomes the
place where a long task happens: if something takes more than about thirty
seconds, it ends in the app that owns it.

## Price

- 29 € once, for life. Launch price until 31 December 2026, then 39 €.
- Or 4 € per month, cancellable at any time. Same app, same features.
- 14-day trial, no account to create. One license covers two Macs.
- Payment by Polar (merchant of record); the license key arrives by email.

## Privacy

- No account, no Fronton server, no usage statistics in the app.
- The AI runs on the Mac. Clipboard history stays on the Mac.
- The site measures audience with Pirsch (cookieless, hosted in Germany).
- What leaves the Mac, call by call, is listed on the legal page.

## Requirements

macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Not available for Intel Macs.
Notarised by Apple. Updates in-app through Sparkle, and they can be turned off.
